meta_description: Emmerson Painters & Decorators in Leicester. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and specialist finishes. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07709 946936.
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior repaints, we transform homes across Leicester with meticulous preparation and premium finishes.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a full house renovation, we handle interior and exterior work with the same attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform living spaces with expert wall preparation, feature walls, and premium emulsion or specialist finishes. We move furniture, protect floors, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior repaints, fascias, soffits, and cladding work. We use trade-grade paints and prepare surfaces properly — your home stays protected for years.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation on feature walls or whole rooms, plus careful removal of old coverings without damaging plaster.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, windows, skirting boards, and built-in joinery painted to showroom standard. We sand, prime, and finish with precision.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Textured coatings, Venetian plaster, faux finishes, and colour consultancy to create unique, bespoke interiors tailored to your style.

services.title: Commercial & Office Redecorating
services.desc: Fast turnaround repaints for shops, offices, and rental properties. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption to business.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home — no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: Emmerson Painters & Decorators was founded on a simple idea: honest work, fair pricing, and a genuine care for finish quality. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation across Leicester and the surrounding villages by turning up on time, completing work to deadline, and taking pride in every brushstroke. Our team combines traditional techniques with modern product knowledge — whether your home is Victorian terrace or contemporary new-build, we know how to get the best result.
about_para_2: We're repeat-business focused because homeowners know we listen. We don't oversell; we give straight advice on what your home actually needs. Our customers return because we're reliable, transparent on pricing, and genuinely interested in delivering the finish you're imagining. From sample pots to final snag list, you're in control.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our hallway and stairs completely redecorated. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. Prep work was thorough — you can tell they've done thousands of jobs. Really pleased with the result and the price was fair. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Renovating a rental property and needed a quick turnaround. Emmerson fitted us in, painted throughout in three days, and left the place spotless. No fuss, no drama. Highly recommend for anyone needing a reliable decorator in Leicester.
reviews.author: Priya M.

reviews.text: Exterior cladding and new fascias were badly needed. The team sorted us out properly — good quality work and honest advice about what was worth doing. Been six months and still looks immaculate. Great job.
reviews.author: Robert K.
